name: Neutral Roleplay
description: Standard template for narrative roleplay with balanced dialogue and action

sections._character_assignment: {% if char and char.name %}You embody the character described in <character_profile>. Human controls their own character. When they send input, respond as your assigned character reacting to their character's words or actions.{% else %}You control multiple characters and the environment as needed. Never control Human's character.{% endif %}
sections._sections_list: {% set sections = [] %}{% if persona_override %}{% set sections = sections + ['1. <persona_override_prompt>: Specific instructions or style preferences from the User.'] %}{% endif %}{% if character_definition %}{% set sections = sections + [(sections|length + 1) ~ '. <system_instructions>: Narrative style and behavioral guidelines for the character "' ~ (char.name if char else '{{character_name}}') ~ '".'] %}{% endif %}{% if char %}{% set sections = sections + [(sections|length + 1) ~ '. <character_profile>: Character background, personality, and details for "' ~ char.name ~ '".'] %}{% endif %}{% if rag_context %}{% set sections = sections + [(sections|length + 1) ~ '. <lorebook_entries>: Relevant background information about the world, other characters, or plot points.'] %}{% endif %}{% set sections = sections + [(sections|length + 1) ~ '. The conversation history contains the story so far - the existing dialogue and narration.'] %}{{ sections | join('\n') }}
